title: Frontend Performance Testing with Lighthouse — Runnable Examples
title_es: Testing de Performance Frontend con Lighthouse — Ejemplos ejecutables
description: Lighthouse 12 performance testing setup: a Puppeteer 24 audit script printing the five weighted metrics, a Lighthouse CI 0.14 lighthouserc.json with Core Web Vitals assertions, and a GitHub Actions gate.
description_es: Setup de testing de performance con Lighthouse 12: script de auditoría con Puppeteer 24 que imprime las cinco métricas ponderadas, un lighthouserc.json de Lighthouse CI 0.14 con assertions de Core Web Vitals y un gate de GitHub Actions.
